 Joining Pelle Larsson (illness) on the team's final injury report, Thompson will not be playing for the Heat's NBA Cup showdown on Friday against the Cleveland Cavaliers due to left ankle soreness.
 Klay Thompson out for Miami Heat with ankle injury vs. Cavs
 Klay Thompson was initially listed as probable by the Miami Heat ahead of Friday's game against the Cleveland Cavaliers. However, it became clear that he won't be suiting up after the team downgraded his status to questionable hours ahead of the home showcase.
 Thompson sat out during Thursday's practice due to his ankle injury. As such, the Heat will let him take a needed break to recover.
 Tim Hardaway Jr., Ryan Conwell, and Simone Fontecchio should be ready for Miami with the former NBA star unavailable to play.
 Appearing in 11 games so far this season, Thompson is averaging 14.4 points on 40.8% three-point shooting with 1.9 assists and 1.6 rebounds.
 After a slow season start, the Heat (5-6) will enter their Friday clash against the Cavs (6-6) looking to extend their two-game win streak.
